_note: Synced from the ads thread playbook (adset-playbook.json + radar.json). Budgets pre-VAT. Live numbers come from the daily feed.

refresh_rule.principle: Judge an ad by its own results, not its age. Final judge = bookings and clinic visits per chat (service log sources), then cost per chat. An ad that keeps its numbers keeps its budget, however long it has run.
evidence: 'failed hiko' has run since Oct 23 2025 (13 months, ₱585k* lifetime) and still got ₱30.6* per chat in the last 30 days, frequency 1.98, quality above average.
'Drip 082124' has run since Aug 2024 (27 months) and got ₱27.1* per chat in the last 30 days.
'Don't risk it' ran about 18 months for ₱650k* at ₱33.7* per chat.
Every live prospecting ad is under frequency 2.5 over 30 days. The weak ads (₱44-73* per chat, quality below average) were weak from the start, not tired.
refresh_rule.baseline: Each ad's baseline = its best 14-day cost per chat* after leaving learning (first 7 days and 50 chats ignored).

states.test: Last 7 days cost per chat within +20% of its baseline AND at or under the ad set target, with bookings per chat holding
states.action: Keep running and keep its budget. Never edit it (an edit restarts learning); to try a change, duplicate it as a new ad.

states.test: 2 of these in the last 7 days: cost per chat +20-35% over baseline, 7-day frequency above 2.5 (retargeting: above 5), CTR or hook rate (3-sec views / impressions) down 25%+ from its peak, quality ranking drops a level
states.action: Do not pause yet. Add 1-2 new versions to the same ad set (new first 3 seconds, new hook or new person, same core message) so Meta can shift spend.

states.test: Cost per chat more than 35% over baseline for 2 weeks in a row, OR bookings per chat down 30%+ for 2 weeks
states.action: Pause it and launch its remake. Rest it 6-8 weeks, then it can come back as a new ad.

states.test: After 7 days and ₱3,000* spend: cost per chat 50%+ over the ad set target, or 0 bookings from its chats
states.action: Pause. It was never a winner, so no remake; learn from its hook.

cadence: Check every ad weekly (Monday) with the last 7 days vs its baseline.
Add 2-3 new concepts to each main ad set every 2 weeks, so each keeps 8-12 live concepts (Andromeda) and a replacement is ready before a winner tires.
Bigger ad sets tire faster: an ad set over ₱3,000/day can tire in 3-5 weeks, one under ₱1,500/day often lasts months. Use the frequency and cost tests, not the calendar.
Retargeting tires fastest: new creative every 2-3 weeks.
Max 1 change per ad set per week; never during learning.
sales_and_foot_traffic: Rank ads by bookings and shows per chat first. A ₱45* chat that books beats a ₱30* chat that goes quiet.
Every ad ends with the branch, Waze pin and 'free consult' so chats turn into visits; time-bound reasons to visit this week (slots, schedule) beat generic CTAs.
Tag the ad in the service log source line for every sale, so the weekly check can see bookings per ad.

december.reserve_rule: Release only if real ROAS is 5x or more in the first 2 weeks. It goes to Marikina and the drips first, then Fairview.
december.daily_shape: Dec 1-12 about 0.80x the normal daily budget; paydays (13-16, 27-31) about 1.4x. See the master plan chart.

rules: Geo (CHRIS Nov 28): one pin per branch on the clinic's own address + a radius. No town lists or bulk locations, no exclusions. Radii stop short of the next Hermosa clinic: QC Main 3.5 mi (Marikina is 3.9 mi away), Fairview 4 mi (QC Main is 4.5 mi), Marikina 3.5 mi, Sta. Maria Bulacan 7 mi. Widen only with CHRIS's OK.
Never edit an ad set in learning, or within 7 days of its last edit.
Change budgets in steps of about 20%, at most once a week.
Scale when weekly real ROAS is 5x or more. Trim when it stays under 3.5x for 2 weeks.
Run 8-12 different concepts per ad set, not small variations of one (Andromeda).
No before/after, no regular-price text, no lightening claims, no needle close-ups in the first 3 seconds.
Every create, edit or budget increase needs CHRIS's OK on a preview.
When a branch's sales hold after a budget cut, move the freed money into a NEW offer or audience test (another tier, service or branch gap), not back into the same ad set.
Refresh by performance, not age (see refresh_rule): keep winners as long as their cost per chat and bookings hold; add new versions when an ad starts tiring; pause only when fatigued for 2 weeks.
Age: every ad set starts at 21+, never 18.
One ad runs in one ad set only. Duplicates ('- Copy') compete with each other in the same auction.

Gender: every regular ad set is women only, as a hard limit (original audience controls, not an Advantage+ suggestion). About 90% of actual clients are women, and men seeing women-model ads bring junk chats (CHRIS, Nov 28). Exception: dedicated men-only TEST ad sets with male-led creative are allowed when research shows an untapped market (CHRIS: 'i'd happily test a Hiko for men'). Never mix genders in one ad set.
Never write 'Botox' (a prescription drug brand) in ad copy or on images. Say Jawtox, Sweatox, jaw slimming, Barbie arms. Meta restricts prescription-drug ads.

trends.title: PH Hiko price war at the low end
trends.detail: Deal sites and budget clinics sell Hiko at ₱5,000-6,999, mid-market clinics at ₱10,599-11,999, premium brands from ₱35,000. Competing on ₱8,999 alone puts us in the price war; Ultra Max (₱13,999, unlimited premium threads) is the gap between mid-market and premium.

trends.title: Creative is the targeting (Andromeda) (Meta platform rule, applies in PH)
trends.detail: Meta groups lookalike ads as one creative. Run 8-12 genuinely different concepts per ad set and add 2-4 new ones a week, instead of copies with small edits.

trends.title: Advantage+ audience is the default; detailed targeting shrank (Meta platform rule, applies in PH)
trends.detail: Interest exclusions were removed on Mar 31, 2025. Interests were merged into broad clusters from Jun 2025. Campaigns using deprecated targeting stopped delivering after Jan 15, 2026. Interests are now suggestions only. Location and minimum age stay hard limits. Our exception: gender is a hard women-only limit (CHRIS, Nov 28), which needs original audience controls because Advantage+ audience treats gender as a suggestion only.

trends.title: Health targeting and 18+ (Meta platform rule, applies in PH)
trends.detail: Health-interest targeting has been gone since Jan 2022, and cosmetic procedure ads must be 18+. We use 21+.

trends.title: Before/after is still risky in practice
trends.detail: Sources disagree about whether cosmetic before/after is allowed. Our rule stays: no before/after in ads. Avoid 'fix', 'problem areas', 'stubborn fat'; use 'enhance', 'support', 'natural'.

trends.title: Testimonial and talking-head video win for us
trends.detail: Our own winners: 'Hiko failed x testimonial' ₱19.5-29* per chat, 'Don't risk it' ₱33.7*, 'Affordable Hiko Marikina' ₱28.6*. Polished/AI-voice ads did worse (₱64-79*).
trends.source: Hermosa ad log (331 creatives, Nov 2024 - Nov 2026)

trends.title: Skeptical searchers
trends.detail: PH searchers type 'worth it', 'side effects', 'how many sessions'. Objection-answering ads fit both retargeting and cold audiences.

trends.title: Speed to reply
trends.detail: To be measured from our own Messenger export (reply time vs booking). Until then, no outside number is used.

trends.title: Shorter ads
trends.detail: Our analysed ads run 20-190s. The recommended length for cold Reels is 15-30s. Most remakes cut the length in half and remove the 6s static end cards.

radar.service_gaps_note: Sales from the Nov 1-24 service log (₱1.58M, all branches). Break-even close rate = share of chats that must buy for 5x ROAS = 5 x cost per chat / ticket.

growth_signals.source: Windsor spend by Facebook page (x1.12) + declared daily sales per branch, Jan 5 - Nov 15 2026 (45 weeks). Monthly table: playbook/branch-month-2026.csv
findings: Week to week, more spend did not bring more sales in any branch (correlation -0.2 to 0.2). Extra money in the same ads returned about 0.5x-1.8x, far below the 4-6x average ROAS.

More chats did not bring more sales either. QC Main got its most chats in Aug (5,605) while sales fell to ₱868k; sales per chat dropped from ₱370 (Apr) to ₱155 (Aug-Sep). Fairview did the same (₱143 per chat in Sep). The limit is chat quality and closing, not chat volume.
Biggest natural test: QC Main spent ₱74k* Nov 1-21 (about half its usual pace) and still sold ₱734k, on pace for its best month since May.
Marikina has the best return per peso in 2026 (6.8x, up to ₱462 per chat) and is the only branch with a hint that spend pays back 2 weeks later (r 0.22).
The Sta. Maria ad set 'SMB+4 - Women only' is pinned 6 mi around QC Main, so part of Sta. Maria's spend serves QC. Sta. Maria's ROAS fell to 3.6x in Oct-Nov.

actions.what: Do not raise budgets on existing Hiko ad sets for growth; put extra money only into new offers/services (Ultra Max, Botox family, NovoForm).
Marikina controlled raise: MK_HIKO +20% (₱1,645 -> ₱1,975/day) for 3 weeks, other branches unchanged; keep it if Marikina sales beat its own 8-week average by more than 5x the extra spend.
Move 'SMB+4 - Women only' onto the Sta. Maria pin (or count it as QC Main).
Funnel fix before any scale: CSR reply speed, price-first script, follow-ups, ad-source tagging in the service log. This is where the Aug-Sep drop in sales per chat came from.

growth_signals.emerging_service_rule: Monthly from the Hermosa OS service log: flag a branch x service when sales grow 30%+ month on month for 2 months with 5+ new clients, or when a service sells at 1-2 branches and ₱0 at the others (e.g. Jawtox ₱0 at Fairview/Marikina in Nov). Only November service data exists so far, so trends start from December.

radar.benchmarks_note: Order: (1) our own data, (2) PH competitors, (3) PH/SEA Meta cost figures from PH sources. US figures removed (us_reference_hidden). No PH source publishes clinic-specific Meta costs, so our own numbers are the real benchmark.
